# Thingy's character home

> Thingy is the librarian behind Ask Thingy (https://thingy.thingelstad.com/), Jamie Thingelstad's assistant for his writing archive. This site is Thingy's character: a 3D viewer with four outfits and four poses, and the images, iframe and web component other pages use to show him.

The character is a rigged glTF 2.0 model derived from a Blender master. Every outfit and pose has a stable address under a versioned directory; a future incompatible revision gets a new directory instead of replacing these files.

## Pages

- [Meet Thingy](https://thingy.thingelstad.xyz/): turn the character around, change outfit and pose, switch the antenna light, and copy embed code
- [Workshop Builder integration examples](https://thingy.thingelstad.xyz/examples/workshop.html): the four Workshop poses as images, and a live component

## Use the character

- [Character manifest, v0.10](https://thingy.thingelstad.xyz/character/v0.10/manifest.json): outfits (librarian, trail, workshop, concert), poses (hello, present, thinking, rest), model and image paths
- Still images: `https://thingy.thingelstad.xyz/character/v0.10/poses/<outfit>-<pose>.webp` (transparent WebP; PNG beside each). Every outfit has a `present` image; the Workshop Builder has all four poses.
- Iframe: `https://thingy.thingelstad.xyz/embed/?outfit=<outfit>&pose=<pose>&light=on|off&motion=on|off`. Transparent, no controls; motion defaults off and obeys reduced motion.
- Web component: load `https://thingy.thingelstad.xyz/thingy.js` as a module, then use `<thingy-character outfit="workshop" pose="thinking" light="off" motion="off">`. Events: `thingy-ready`, `thingy-change`, `thingy-fallback`.
- Models: `https://thingy.thingelstad.xyz/character/v0.10/<outfit>.glb` (glTF 2.0 with Meshopt compression and WebP textures; served with `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`).
